items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI3ODU0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7d2fc12a35db298f2e38862651d90ae3e2537592/logo%20cuaad%20open.png) **¿Listos para competir con las mejores vistas?** Los invitamos a disfrutar de un día lleno de cubos, convivencia y de las hermosas vistas a la Barranca de Huentitán en el Centro Universitario de Arte, Arquitectura y Diseño, sede Huentitán de la UDG. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) y organizadores con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. Consúltalo aquí www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ **Ready to compete with the best views?** We invite you to enjoy a day full of cubes, community, and the beautiful sights of the Huentitán Canyon at the University Center of Art, Architecture, and Design, Huentitán campus of the University of Guadalajara. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a) **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) and organizers for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. Check it here www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar. Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubetecCEFETTimoteo2025/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$20. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. ### 🇺🇸 English Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate. In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization. Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubetecCEFETTimoteo2025/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. The registration fee is R${20. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: ### Português Para pagamento da taxa de inscrição de R$ 12,00, utilize a **chave PIX 11960499760** (Isabela Lopes) e envie o comprovante de pagamento com o nome completo do competidor para o email **[campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com]**(mailto:campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com) Esta competição possui **limite de inscrições**, em caso de desistência, **entre em contato com a organização ([campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com](mailto:campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com))** para que a vaga possa ser disponibilizada para outra pessoa. **Atualização (28/08/2025):** Atingimos o limite de competidores, todas as inscrições pagas serão direcionadas para a lista de espera. Estas são as orientações para a lista de espera: * Um competidor só é adicionado à lista de espera após o compartilhamento do comprovante de pagamento conforme orientado acima; * Caso um competidor com inscrição já confirmada cancele sua inscrição, chamaremos o primeiro competidor da lista, na ordem de compartilhamento do comprovante, via e-mail. Este terá 48 horas para confirmar que ainda possui interesse. Caso não haja resposta, chamaremos o próximo da lista; * Na ocasião de haver competidores da lista de espera que não consigam uma vaga para competir, o preço de inscrição será reembolsado integralmente após a competição, com contato via e-mail. **ATENÇÃO:** Como atingimos o limite de competidores, **NÃO HAVERÁ INSCRIÇÕES NO LOCAL.** #### Utilização de imagem Assim como em outras edições do Golden Square Shopping, há possibilidade de filmagem e fotografias durante a competição, por parte do shopping ou veículos de mídia autorizados. Ao se inscrever, você concorda que sua imagem pode ser utilizada pelo shopping ou seus parceiros, com fins monetários ou não, sem compensação ou crédito necessário. Ao manter sua inscrição, você também reconhece a leitura e ciência deste aviso. ### English: To pay the registration fee of R$ 12.00, use the PIX key 11960499760 (Isabela Lopes) and send the receipt with the competitor's full name to the following email address [campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com](mailto:campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com) This competition has a **competitor limit**, in case of withdrawal, **contact the organization team ([campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com](mailto:campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com))** so your spot can be given to someone else. **Update (28/08/2025):** We have reached the competitor limit, all paid registrations will go straight to the waiting list. These are the guidelines for the Waiting List: * A competitor is only added to the waiting list once the payment receipt has been shared as specified above; * If a competitor with a confirmed registration cancels his registration, we will email the first competitor on the waiting list, in the order we receive the receipts. They will have 48 hours to confirm they are still interested. If there is no answer, we will email the next competitor on the list; * If there are competitors on the waiting list who don't have the chance for a spot to compete, the price of the registration will be refunded entirely after the competition, through email contact. **Attention:** As we reached the competitor limit, **THERE WILL BE NO ON THE SPOT REGISTRATIONS.** #### Image use As with previous editions of Golden Square Shopping, it's possible there will be photography and filming at the event, done by the mall or authorized media outlets. By registering, you agree that your image might be used by the shopping mall or its partners, for monetary gain or other purposes, without compensation or credit necessary. By keeping your registration, you also recognize to have read and granted permission to this.

items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDFall2024#43160-competitor-responsibilities) tab. # This competition is primarily an Unofficial Events competition. You can register for unofficial events [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDUnofficialEvents2025#59768-must-read-unofficial-events-info-registration) Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. **UCSD students can get their registration fee waived!** More details in the **"UCSD Student Registration Fee Waiver"** tab. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) A portion of the profits from this competition will be donated to the Rubik's Cube Club @ UC San Diego, a registered UC San Diego Student Organization.

items.name: UFRO al Cubo 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI3NDQ5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8508a7db554ceb1fb5f2737c95b0d49e690d3fcb/Blue%20and%20White%20Circle%20Surfing%20Club%20Logo%20(11).png) **Español** Con mucha alegría y orgullo anunciamos en colaboración con la Universidad de La Frontera, que Temuco será por primera vez sede de una competencia oficial de Cubo Rubik. Más que una competencia, "UFRO al Cubo 2025" será una oportunidad única para compartir la pasión por el mundo Rubik y disfrutar de un ambiente lleno de colores, cubos y comunidad. ¡Los esperamos! **English** It is with great joy and pride that we announce, in collaboration with the Universidad De La Frontera, that Temuco will host an official Rubik's Cube competition for the first time. More than just a competition, "UFRO al Cubo 2025" will be a unique opportunity to share the passion for the Rubik's Cube and enjoy an atmosphere full of colors, cubes, and community. We look forward to seeing you!
